points.title: Present perfect with for/since

points.title: Must and have to
examples: I have to work on Friday.

examples: You don't have to come early.

sections.title: Listening: Work & Study Routines
sections.description: Listen once for gist and again for detail.

audio.transcript: I've attended an evening design course since September. I work during the day, so I have to study after dinner. We must hand in an assignment every two weeks, but we don't have to attend class on Fridays. This month has been busy because my colleague is away and I have worked extra shifts. I haven't missed a deadline yet, although I have had to plan my time carefully.

gistQuestions.explanation: The complete recording supports this main idea.

detailQuestions.prompt: How often is an assignment due?
detailQuestions.explanation: This detail is stated in the recording. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

tip.title: Listening Strategy
tip.text: Use the first listen for context and the second listen to confirm exact details.

sections.title: Speaking: Work & Study Routines
sections.description: Prepare briefly, record your response and review it.
questions: Describe your work or study routine.
How long have you followed this routine?
sections.sampleAnswer: I have studied English for one year. I attend class twice a week and have to complete homework online. I must practise regularly, but I don't have to study at the same time every day.
prompts: Answer every part of the prompt.

tip.title: Speaking Tip
tip.text: Organise your answer into a clear beginning, two details and a short ending.
